name: Back Office Orders
description: Takeaway and click-and-collect orders as a four-column board — new, preparing, ready, collected — with pick-up times, payment status, one-tap advance and print.
usage: Give it the /admin/orders route. Load today's orders from your shop or payment provider (Square, Stripe, Shopify) and save stage changes in onStageChange — a good place to text the customer when an order is ready. Security: put every back-office screen behind sign-in (for example Supabase Auth or Clerk), let only the owner's account read or write this data (in Supabase, with row-level security on every table), and keep admin pages out of the public navigation and sitemap.
